description.value: Caramba Restaurant is a locally owned European-Italian comfort food destination established in 1995 in the heart of Whistler Village, built around a wood-burning pizza oven and an open kitchen. Run by owner-operators Jay and James Pare, it draws both visitors and locals with handcrafted pastas, wood-fired pizzas, and craft cocktails in a lively, casual atmosphere. Takeout is available, making it a practical refuelling stop for cyclists moving through the village.

address.value: 12-4314 Main St, Town Plaza, Whistler, BC V0N 1B4
